text:
Maggie Hart: Hey everyone! I started today — hi 👋 I’m Maggie (she/they). I’ll be on infra/product for the next few months. I like birdwatching, tiny guitars, and sudoku puzzles. Looking forward to meeting folks in person soon :bird: :guitar:
Jamie Lee: Welcome Maggie!! :tada: Folks in SF are doing a quick rooftop lunch tomorrow if you want to swing by. Also pinging IT for your badge — @it-ops. 
Luis Park: hey maggie, welcome! love the sudoku. we have a tiny-puzzles drawer in eng kitchen if you want to rescue it :smile:
Priya Singh: Hi Maggie — welcome! what kind of birds do you look for? we’ve got a few amateur birders here. also coffee or tea? poll: coffee/tea/iced
Noah Kim: welcome! if you play guitar bring it to the next friday social, we have a half-hour open jam. also FYI badge should be ready by noon — I emailed IT earlier
Maggie Hart: thanks all! I’ll try to make rooftop lunch. birds: mainly city sparrows and the occasional hawk if I’m lucky. Coffee > tea, but will take iced on warm days :coffee: 
Zoe Martinez: :wave: welcome! quick Q — any snack preferences/allergies for the lunch order? GF/vegan ok?
Maggie Hart: no allergies, vegan is fine. thanks for checking! 
Luis Park: added to the logistics thread. also leaving a sudoku on your desk (small one) :nerd_face:
Jamie Lee: Badge update: IT says ready for pickup at reception. I’ll leave a sticky note on the desk with lunch details. Welcome again :party_parrot:
Maggie Hart: you’re all too kind, thank you 🙂 see you tomorrow!
